name: project_path_doctor
purpose: Windows PATH auditor that reports dead entries, duplicates and shadowed executables, resolving machine and user PATH in true composition order.
notes: First Rust project on this machine, chosen as a workflow shakedown. Deliberately read-only in slice 1: it reports, it never writes PATH. Born from real PATH shadowing hit during machine provisioning on 2026-09-15. Slice 1 progress: registry reading and PATH composition done (winreg, chosen over the windows crate so the unsafe stays in the dependency), plus the output layer - table, colour, and a versioned JSON contract documented in docs/SPEC.md. A GUI is a confirmed future consumer, so the serialisation shape is defined once in pathdoc-core behind a serde feature rather than mirrored in the front end. Remaining in slice 1: executable enumeration, PATHEXT handling, shadow detection, and the Unreadable finding.
